tool_args.rationale: The pilot covers only H≤0.48, while the target is H=20. The authorized mechanism and co-activation guidance identify a five-parameter sink-coupled dual-horizon law whose slow adaptation requires long-horizon observations.

considered_alternatives.option: Fit sink-coupled dual-horizon model from pilot alone
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: Five short-horizon rows cannot reliably identify both fast and slow timescales or the long-horizon adaptation.
Long-horizon discrimination is more directly relevant to the H=20 target.
Irrelevant to identification of the temporal mechanism.
